While underway, a perpetrator armed with 
a knife was sighted in the engine room 
workshop. The perpetrator attempted to 
threaten the engine room watchkeeping 
staff, who ran away and secured himself 
in the engine control room. The master 
was informed and the general alarm was 
activated. 
 
The agent of vessel reported to Maritime 
and Port Authority of Singapore (MPA). 
Safety broadcast on anti-piracy watch 
was carried out to warn all vessels to 
maintain a vigilant watch at all times in the 
Singapore Strait (SS).  
Nothing was 
stolen 
 
The crew 
members were 
not injured. 
All crew 
mustered and a 
search was 
conducted, with 
no further 
sighting of the 
perpetrators.
